verdict.rationale: Kintsugi provides nexus tracking, filings, registrations, and exemption APIs (get-filings, create-registration, get-nexus-for-org) that could surface liability by jurisdiction, and product categorization determines taxability, but there's no explicit documentation of a 'collected vs owed' liability dashboard or accountant/GL-ready export format. missing for 10: explicit accrued-liability-by-jurisdiction view/report, collected-vs-owed reconciliation feature, documented GL/accountant export formats (e.g. CSV/QBO/NetSuite journal entries), independent confirmation of filing-ready detail accuracy.
